title: papaver coloradense var. typicum
intro:
Papaver coloradense var. typicum, commonly known as Colorado poppy, is a perennial plant species in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). This plant is known for its vibrant orange-red flowers and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Papaver coloradense var. typicum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been attributed to its potential therapeutic actions in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: There is limited information available about this specific plant. However, the information provided is based on general knowledge about related plants in the Papaveraceae family.
